pages.title: Runs Like Clockwork
pages.text: Learn unattended routing without claiming that holding a blank schedule is enough.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Create a valid schedule with two distinct stops and hand it to the native train operator. Completion requires departure and scheduled arrival.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Program a Schedule and give it to an eligible seated mob or Blaze Burner facing the controls. Run a train service through its programmed destinations and wait conditions.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Send a scheduled train through a section outside player-loaded chunks. It follows tracks, stations and signals, but onboard drills and machines stop operating there.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Use the documented dynamic delay or prioritized destination schedule entries. Adapt scheduled train service using the addon's schedule instructions.
